description: This file contains Redux reducer functions and related logic for managing thread-related state in a Mattermost application, including handling received threads, thread follow changes, and thread deletions within team contexts.

methods.name: shouldAddThreadId
methods.description: Determines if a thread should be added based on whether it is newer than existing threads.

methods.name: handlePostRemoved
methods.description: Handles removal of a post from thread state, updating relevant team thread lists.

methods.name: handleAllTeamsReceivedThread
methods.description: Adds a thread to all teams in the current state.

methods.name: handleSingleTeamReceivedThread
methods.description: Adds a thread to a specific team if it is newer than existing threads.

methods.name: handleReceivedThread
methods.description: Handles the reception of a new thread, updating state for a specific team or all teams.

methods.name: handleFollowChanged
methods.description: Updates thread follow status, adding or removing threads based on follow/unfollow actions.

methods.name: handleReceiveThreads
methods.description: Handles bulk reception of threads for a team.

methods.name: handleLeaveChannel
methods.description: Removes threads associated with a channel when leaving or deleting the channel.

methods.name: handleLeaveTeam
methods.description: Removes all threads associated with a team when leaving the team.

methods.name: handleSingleTeamThreadRead
methods.description: Updates unread thread lists when a thread is marked as read or unread.
